original_abstract.text: Attention remains a substantial computational cost in Transformer training, particularly at long context lengths. NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs provide high-throughput low-precision matrix multiplication, but exploiting it in attention requires addressing quantization overhead, causal information leakage through shared scales, and numerical inconsistencies between the forward and backward passes. We present FLAMIA, a family of attention kernels for Blackwell with MXFP8 and mixed NVFP4/FP8 training paths. Our design combines token-block scaling that reuses quantized operands across matrix orientations, targeted safeguards against scale-induced leakage, and consistent forward and backward computations. Fused quantization and architecture-specific kernel optimizations reduce overhead, while document-local scaling and workload-aware scheduling support variable-length documents directly in packed layouts without repacking. Across various causal packed-document workloads, the MXFP8 path accelerates the combined forward and backward attention call, including quantization, by factors of $1.10$--$1.40\times$ on B200 and $1.06$--$1.42\times$ on B300 relative to the fastest evaluated baseline for each workload. We validate training stability and quality preservation on pretraining Llama-style models. These results show how jointly designing quantization, training numerics, and document scheduling translates low-bit hardware throughput into practical attention acceleration.
original_abstract.source_title: FLAMIA: FLAsh MIcroscaling Attention for Fast and Causally Safe Training on Blackwell

en.text: FLAMIA co-designs microscaling quantization, consistent forward/backward numerics and packed-document scheduling for Blackwell attention training. Including quantization, its MXFP8 path accelerates combined forward and backward attention by 1.10–1.40× on B200 and 1.06–1.42× on B300 against the fastest evaluated baseline per workload, with Llama-style pretraining checks.

zh.text: FLAMIA协同设计微缩放量化、前后向数值一致性和打包文档调度，以加速Blackwell上的注意力训练。计入量化开销后，MXFP8路径的注意力前后向合计速度，在B200上为各负载最强已测基线的1.10—1.40倍、B300上为1.06—1.42倍，并进行了Llama式预训练验证。

original_abstract.text: Computer programmers chain together the same reusable computational primitives, for example, conditional statements or loops, but in different orders to implement different algorithms. In contrast, existing language model architectures always execute their layers in the same order. We introduce Library of Layers (LoL), an architecture that dynamically orders its layers during inference to solve the problem at hand. LoL has a single hyperparameter, the size of its global library of transformer blocks, that allows it to transition seamlessly between parameter reuse and sparsity, generalizing the parameter-efficiency and FLOPs-efficiency tradeoffs of dense, depth-recurrent, and mixture of experts architectures in one unified family. We show that LoL achieves competitive performance with all three above baselines when pretrained on text data. On synthetic sudoku and maze data, we observe that the model employs distinct layer orderings to implement different solution strategies, and we can intervene on routing to force a model to apply a specific solution strategy to a problem instance. In a multilingual natural language setting, we find that LoL chooses different layer order patterns based on language and script. Similarly, we train LoL on safety data and fit probes to its router outputs, finding that these probes distinguish safe from unsafe text with high AUROC. LoL provides a path toward a future in which models dynamically compose their own computational graph, enabling more efficient and controllable reasoning.
original_abstract.source_title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime

en.text: Library of Layers dynamically selects the order of Transformer blocks from a shared library at inference. Library size interpolates between parameter reuse and sparse computation; text pretraining is competitive with dense, recurrent and MoE baselines, while synthetic and multilingual studies expose input-dependent layer ordering.

zh.text: Library of Layers在推理时从共享Transformer模块库中动态选择执行顺序，借模块库规模调节参数复用与稀疏计算。文本预训练表现可与稠密、循环和MoE基线竞争，合成任务及多语言实验显示执行顺序随输入改变。

original_abstract.text: Most parameters of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model belong to its experts, and standard training keeps every expert gradient in GPU memory until the optimizer step. This memory grows with the number and size of the experts, so it rises as MoE models scale. We introduce Sonar-MoE, which updates each expert tensor during the backward pass and frees its gradient right away. It brings optimizer-in-backward from dense models to batched MoE expert tensors, so the GPU never holds more than one layer of expert gradients. When we fine-tune OLMoE-1B-7B and Granite-3.1-3B-A800M in bf16 with two expert-kernel backends, Sonar-MoE lowers peak memory by 19% to 22%. Its updates are bitwise identical to standard training without expert gradient clipping, and held-out loss stays within 0.003 of all baselines. Each step also takes 17% to 23% less time than standard training with global-norm clipping. Updating whole batched tensors rather than individual experts is what keeps Sonar-MoE fast, as it avoids a 20% to 72% slowdown while using the same memory. Sonar-MoE matches optimizer-in-backward over all parameters in memory and speed while still clipping the dense parameters.
original_abstract.source_title: Sonar-MoE: In-Backward Expert Updates for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training

en.text: Sonar-MoE updates batched expert tensors during backpropagation and releases their gradients immediately, limiting resident expert gradients to one layer. BF16 fine-tuning of two MoE models reduces peak memory by 19–22%; updates match standard training bitwise without expert gradient clipping, while step time falls 17–23% relative to global-norm-clipped training.

zh.text: Sonar-MoE在反向传播中按批量专家张量执行优化器更新并立即释放梯度，使显存中至多保留一层专家梯度。两个MoE模型的BF16微调中峰值显存降低19%—22%；不裁剪专家梯度时更新与标准训练逐位一致，相比全局范数裁剪训练每步时间缩短17%—23%。

original_abstract.text: In the near future language model pretraining will become bound by total data rather than total compute. Such a regime requires revisiting scaling laws and scaling law theory. Motivated by prior works that have found utility in ensembling, we study how the number of training epochs and ensemble size jointly shape generalization when training data are fixed. In language-model experiments on FineWeb, logit averaging reduces late-training deterioration, delays optimal stopping, and can outperform wider or deeper single models at matched parameter-token budgets over a common training horizon. To analyze this interaction between data reuse and ensembling, we derive a dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) for multi-epoch stochastic gradient descent in power-law random-feature ensembles, tracking error correlations across epochs and models. Ensembling reduces the prediction variance responsible for late-time growth in expected test error, changing the optimal stopping time. We use these stopping times to derive compute-allocation laws at fixed data and individual model sizes. Under this allocation, ensemble size grows with compute at least as fast as training time per member, while excess test loss above the limiting loss decreases as a power of compute.
original_abstract.source_title: A Scaling Theory of Multi-Epoch Pretraining: Late-Time Overfitting and Ensembling

en.text: This study asks how to allocate compute between repeated training and ensembling when data are fixed. FineWeb language-model experiments show that logit averaging can reduce late-training deterioration and outperform wider or deeper single models at matched parameter-token budgets over a common training horizon. A dynamical mean-field theory for power-law random-feature ensembles links the benefit to reduced prediction variance and derives allocation laws at fixed data and individual model sizes. Data-limited recommendation may benefit from testing this trade-off, but the theoretical model is not a universal LLM scaling law, and inference cost is not matched by the stated training-budget comparison.

zh.text: 这项研究讨论数据固定时，新增计算该用于多轮训练还是集成。在FineWeb语言模型实验中，logit平均能减轻训练后期退化；在相同训练区间、参数与token乘积预算匹配时，集成可优于更宽或更深的单模型。论文再用幂律随机特征集成的动态平均场理论，把收益联系到预测方差下降，并在固定数据量和单模型规模下推导计算分配规律。数据受限的推荐训练可以检验这一取舍，但该理论并非通用LLM定律，训练预算匹配也不代表推理成本匹配。

original_abstract.text: Sparse attention cuts the cost of long-context inference by making the attention matrix sparse: each query attends only a subset of the sequence, chosen by a fixed pattern or, in recent production LLMs, learned per query. In DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), the attention of DeepSeek-V3.2 and the GLM-5 family, every layer is preceded by a lightning indexer that scores the whole cache and keeps the k=2048 highest-scoring tokens for the layer to attend. At long context this indexer scan, not the sparse attention it feeds, is where the decode time goes. But adjacent layers select nearly the same tokens, so a layer can attend the selection of the previous indexer layer instead of its own. This removes the dependency: each indexer then runs concurrently with the attention of its layer. The resulting Multi-layer Indexer (MLI) needs no retraining and no new weights. Its default realization changes no kernel, running inside SGLang's production decode graph; an optional fused decode kernel accelerates it further on DeepSeek-V3.2. MLI composes with IndexCache (the cross-layer reuse GLM-5.2 ships as IndexShare): IndexCache drops the indexer from some layers, and MLI hides the scan on the rest. We serve DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5 under IndexCache's protocol at retentions 1/2 to 1/32 (the fraction of layers that keep an indexer) and contexts 10K to 195K. At equal retention the composition decodes faster than IndexCache: up to 14.5% faster on DeepSeek-V3.2 and 9.8% on GLM-5 at 1/2, and 7.9% and 5.1% at 1/4, largest where IndexCache keeps the most indexers and growing with context. At retention 1/r it is faster still than IndexCache at 1/(2r) while keeping twice the fresh selections: at 128K it reaches 1.32x the unmodified model's decode throughput at 1/4, above IndexCache's 1.28x at 1/8. Its LongBench, RULER and LongBench v2 accuracy stays within a few percentage points of IndexCache's.
original_abstract.source_title: Multi-layer Indexer: Overlapping Selection and Attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention

en.text: MLI overlaps sparse-attention selection and computation by letting a layer attend to the previous indexer layer's selected tokens while its own indexer runs. It composes with IndexCache's cross-layer reuse and needs no retraining or new weights for its default implementation. In SGLang evaluations on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5, equal-retention decode gains reach 14.5% and 9.8%, respectively; LongBench and RULER quality stays within a few percentage points of IndexCache. It trades selection freshness for overlap rather than proving exact equivalence.

zh.text: MLI利用相邻层选择token高度相似的特点，让当前层先使用上一索引层的候选做注意力计算，同时运行当前索引器，从而打断选择与计算的串行依赖。它可与IndexCache跨层复用叠加，默认实现无需重新训练或新增权重。在DeepSeek-V3.2和GLM-5的SGLang评测中，同索引保留率下解码最多分别提速14.5%和9.8%；LongBench及RULER等质量与IndexCache相差数个百分点，收益来自候选新鲜度与并行度的取舍。

original_abstract.text: Under expert parallelism, mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers pay all-to-all token dispatch, grouped GEMMs, and a combine step in every layer. In decode each rank holds only 1-256 tokens: dispatch latency and weight traffic dominate while tensor-core utilization is inherently low. In fused operators such as DeepGEMM's Mega MoE, dispatch and computation overlap only by sharing every SM: dispatch warps compete with TMA/MMA and epilogue warps for registers, shared memory, and issue slots; every phase shares one CTA resource budget, synchronization spans the whole SM array, and every replay ends with a workspace-clean pass and a cross-rank barrier. We present GC-MoE, an open-source FP8/FP4 MoE inference operator for NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPUs that uses CUDA Green Contexts to split the device into a small communication partition and a large compute partition. Each role gets its own kernel, resource budget, and synchronization domain, so dispatch and GEMM tune independently. A three-node CUDA Graph (four on Hopper with fused shared experts) launches the dispatch and grouped-GEMM kernels as concurrent roots; a token-ring handshake starts computation on the first filled ring blocks, and double-buffered receive counters remove the trailing cross-rank barrier between replays. The compute partition runs operand-swapped tcgen05 block-scaled MMA on Blackwell and register-A WGMMA with in-register FP4 decoding on Hopper, with fused SwiGLU, requantization, and optional shared experts. On 8 H20 GPUs GC-MoE accelerates DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decode by 1.188x on average on both the routed and shared-expert suites (peaks 1.296x and 1.353x); on 8 B300 GPUs it accelerates GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash by 1.106x (1.123x with fused shared experts, peak 1.209x), beating Mega MoE at all 54 measured points at matched accuracy. GC-MoE reserves only 20 of 148 SMs on B300 for dispatch.
original_abstract.source_title: GC-MoE: Overlapping Expert-Parallel Token Dispatch with FP8/FP4 Grouped GEMM via CUDA Green Contexts

en.text: GC-MoE separates expert-parallel dispatch and grouped GEMM onto communication and compute partitions using CUDA Green Contexts. Independent kernels, a token-ring handshake and double-buffered counters overlap work without the usual trailing cross-rank barrier. At matched accuracy, the operator beats Mega MoE across all 54 measured points. On eight H20s, reported DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decode speedup averages 1.188x in both routed and shared-expert suites; on eight B300s, GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash average 1.106x, or 1.123x with fused shared experts. This supports hardware-aware partitioning for sparse inference, not a general recommendation throughput claim.

zh.text: GC-MoE用CUDA Green Contexts把专家并行的token分发与分组GEMM放到独立的通信区和计算区。两套核分别调优，通过token环握手和双缓冲计数器交叠执行，去掉回放末尾的跨卡屏障。在精度匹配时，它在54个测试点都快于Mega MoE：8张H20上，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的路由专家与共享专家测试平均均提速1.188倍；8张B300上，GLM-5.2和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash平均提速1.106倍，融合共享专家后为1.123倍。可借鉴的是稀疏推理的硬件分区方式，并非通用推荐吞吐结论。

original_abstract.text:
Larger generative retrieval models can improve retrieval quality, but their decoding cost makes low-latency serving difficult. When different users submit the same query, generating complete Semantic IDs (SIDs) for every request repeats computation, while their interaction histories call for different results. The challenge is to reuse large-model computation across requests while keeping retrieval personalized.
  We propose \textbf{ReuseGR}, which separates query-level candidate planning from request-level personalized completion. A 7B offline planner generates SID prefix sets shared across requests with the same query. A 0.5B online model uses each request's history to select prefixes and generate the remaining tokens. ReuseCut chooses a cache depth for each query based on historical coverage, balancing computation reuse and candidate coverage. To strengthen online completion, we transfer 7B suffix-scoring knowledge to 0.5B through path-level knowledge distillation (Path KD). BudgetCut then selects scored branches to improve final top-100 recall under a fixed branch budget. Its selection policy is initialized by on-policy distillation (OPD) and refined through group-relative policy optimization (GRPO).
  On an industrial search-advertising dataset with approximately 2M query--item records and 3.38M catalog items, ReuseGR improves query-level HR@100 by 3.83 percentage points and reduces mean online latency by 38.9\% relative to an all-online 0.5B baseline when prefixes are prepared. It achieves HR@100 comparable to an all-online 7B baseline with 57.7\% lower online latency. A 14-day user-level online A/B test against the 0.5B baseline shows relative gains of 0.93\% in click-through rate and 1.05\% in revenue per thousand requests.
original_abstract.source_title: ReuseGR: Offline--Online Decoupled Generative Retrieval via Adaptive Prefix Reuse

en.text: Separates reusable query-level planning from personalized online completion: a 7B offline model generates Semantic-ID prefixes, and a 0.5B online model selects and completes them using user history. Adaptive cache depth, path-level distillation and branch-budget selection balance reuse, coverage and cost. On an industrial search-ad dataset, with prefixes prepared, query-level HR@100 rises by 3.83 percentage points and mean online latency falls 38.9% versus all-online 0.5B; HR@100 is comparable to all-online 7B at 57.7% lower online latency. A 14-day user-level A/B test versus 0.5B reports relative CTR and revenue-per-thousand-request gains of 0.93% and 1.05%. CTR scaling takeaway: amortize large-model compute across repeated queries while retaining request-level personalization; online-latency gains do not include the full offline planning cost.

zh.text: 将可复用的查询级规划与个性化在线补全解耦：7B 离线模型生成 Semantic ID 前缀，0.5B 在线模型根据用户历史选择前缀并补全。自适应缓存深度、路径级知识蒸馏与分支预算选择共同平衡复用、覆盖和计算成本。在工业搜索广告数据上，前缀已准备好的条件下，相比全在线 0.5B，查询级 HR@100 提升 3.83 个百分点、平均在线延迟下降 38.9%；相较全在线 7B，HR@100 相当、在线延迟下降 57.7%。为期 14 天的用户级 A/B 测试中，相比 0.5B 基线，CTR 和每千次请求收入分别相对提升 0.93% 和 1.05%。对 CTR scaling 的启发：跨重复查询摊销大模型计算，同时保留请求级个性化；在线延迟收益不包含完整离线规划成本。

original_abstract.text: We introduce a training-free sparse attention method that builds a prompt-specific key index to accelerate both prefill and decoding. The method clusters the keys into large semantic blocks that group tokens from noncontiguous positions. Each query position selects blocks by scoring their centroids and attends to the original keys and values within them. Queries that select the same block are processed together, so prefill stays fast even though each query chooses its own blocks. Large blocks make centroid scoring and this grouped processing cheap, so each query can attend to more tokens in the same time. Larger blocks with a larger token budget can thus be both faster and more accurate on long-context tasks than smaller blocks with a smaller budget. We evaluate two hybrid LLMs, Qwen3.5-4B and 35B-A3B, on one NVIDIA H200. Including the cost of building and using the index, whole-model wall-clock speedups over dense attention are 2.3-2.4x for prefill and 1.7-2.0x for decoding at 512K tokens, and 2.9-3.0x for prefill at 1M. The 35B-A3B model stays close to dense attention on five RULER tasks through 1M, on LongBench-v2 overall, and on MRCR through 256K. The 4B model loses accuracy mainly on multi-key retrieval, yet outperforms dense Qwen3.5-2B, whose latency is similar at 512K, on all three benchmarks.
original_abstract.source_title: Coarse Semantic Blocks for Efficient Training-Free Sparse Attention

en.text: This training-free sparse-attention method clusters noncontiguous keys into large semantic blocks, selects blocks using centroid scores, and groups queries that access the same block. Including indexing overhead, Qwen3.5 models achieve 2.3–2.4× whole-model prefill speedups at 512K tokens on one H200; the 35B-A3B model remains close to dense attention on several long-context benchmarks. Semantic block selection and grouped execution could reduce long behavior-history attention cost, but CTR accuracy and production ranking latency are untested.

zh.text: 该免训练稀疏注意力方法将非连续位置的 key 聚成较大的语义块，通过质心评分选择块，并合并访问同一块的 query 执行计算。计入建索引开销后，Qwen3.5 模型在单张 H200、512K token 场景中的整模型 prefill 加速达到 2.3–2.4 倍；35B-A3B 模型在多项长上下文评测中接近稠密注意力。语义块筛选与分组执行可为长行为序列注意力降本提供参考，但尚未测试 CTR 精度和线上排序延迟。

original_abstract.text: Parameter-efficient linearization turns a pretrained autoregressive Transformer into an efficient model by hybridizing sliding-window attention (SWA) with a constant-size recurrent memory. But does every layer's recurrent state contribute to long-context retrieval? Investigating an SWA and Test-Time Training (TTT) hybrid, we find that retrieval is sparse across depth, concentrated in a few anchor layers, and that the remaining states hold similar information expressed through layer-specific transformations. We exploit both observations in Anchor: TTT memory placed only at the anchor layers, and a cross-layer recurrent state written once and read by many layers, each through its own learned read map that realizes a layer-specific stretch and rotation, along with demonstrated generalization to other hybrid attentions. On Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, Anchor delivers 2.3-3.1x higher recall and 6.7-8.9 points higher MMLU accuracy than LoLCATs with a 10x smaller recurrent state, retains 91-95% of the teacher's MMLU accuracy, and cuts end-to-end latency by up to 4.3x relative to softmax attention.
original_abstract.source_title: Anchor: Augmented Cross-Layer Recurrent State for Long-Context Retrieval in Test-Time Training

en.text: Anchor finds that long-context retrieval in sliding-window-attention/TTT hybrids concentrates in a few layers. It places recurrent memory at these anchor layers and shares a state that is written once and read through layer-specific maps. On Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, it reports 2.3–3.1× higher recall than LoLCATs with a 10× smaller recurrent state and up to 4.3× lower latency than softmax attention. Shared memory is a promising direction for long user-history rankers, although recommendation transfer is not evaluated.

zh.text: Anchor 发现，滑动窗口注意力与 TTT 混合模型的长上下文检索能力集中在少数层。它仅在这些锚点层设置循环记忆，并共享一次写入、经各层专属映射读取的状态。在 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Mistral-7B 上，相比 LoLCATs，其循环状态缩小至十分之一，召回率达到 2.3–3.1 倍；相比 softmax 注意力，延迟最多降低至约四分之一。共享记忆可为长用户行为序列排序提供思路，但论文未验证推荐场景迁移。

original_abstract.text: In this work, we study end-to-end FP4 reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models. Recent work on FP4 RL has introduced effective recovery recipes that restore accuracy under aggressive low-precision quantization for dense models, but we find that the same approach yields no improvement over the naive FP4 baseline in the MoE setting. We conduct an in-depth study to understand why. Our analysis identifies the root cause in the routing mechanism unique to MoE: because the router makes discrete expert-selection decisions, training-inference policy alignment becomes acutely sensitive to whether the same recovery technique is applied symmetrically on the training and inference sides. When an asymmetric recipe is used-including the dense-model approach, which corrects only the rollout-training-inference alignment deteriorates sharply, as measured by the Pearson correlation coefficient between training and inference probabilities, and router selection matching rates. Building on this finding, we propose MoEResQ, a quantization-recovery recipe for MoE RL post-training that enforces symmetry between the training- and inference-side corrections. MoEResQ restores training-inference alignment and substantially closes the accuracy gap to full precision, establishing symmetric recovery as the key principle in FP4 RL for MoE models.
original_abstract.source_title: Aligning Training and Rollout Policies for End-to-End FP4 RL on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs

en.text: MoEResQ studies quantization recovery for end-to-end FP4 reinforcement-learning post-training of MoE models. Discrete expert routing makes train–rollout alignment sensitive to applying recovery corrections on only one side; the proposed recipe applies them symmetrically. The paper reports restored probability and routing alignment and a smaller accuracy gap to full precision. This is a transferable warning for low-precision sparse routing, not a recommendation-system benchmark.

zh.text: MoEResQ研究MoE模型端到端FP4强化学习后训练中的量化恢复。离散专家选择使训练与采样两侧对校正不对称格外敏感，沿用只校正采样侧的稠密模型配方可能破坏概率与路由一致性；作者改为两侧对称校正，恢复一致性并缩小与全精度的精度差距。对低精度稀疏推荐模型的参考点是同时检查训练、推理与专家选择的一致性，论文自身评测对象是语言模型。

original_abstract.text: Context parallelism (CP) partitions long sequences across GPUs for LLM training and inference. For variable-length training and full prefill, attention-balanced placement can leave token loads uneven, while ring execution repeats overhead at each computation and communication step. In stage-serialized decode CP (DCP), long-running tasks delay dependent work and leave substantial GPU hardware idle. We propose LiquidCP, which unifies training and inference through a common model of Transfer, Compute, and Reduction tasks with tile-level dependencies, decoupling attention tasks from communication and kernel boundaries. For training and full prefill, MegaRing incorporates BuddyRing placement to balance attention and token loads, and coalesces ready KV regions during forward attention to amortize overhead. For decoding and mixed batches, MegaDCP selects history-KV splits by jointly modeling the completion of attention and its dependent reductions. A shared persistent GPU-resident engine executes both designs. Compared with the fastest baseline per configuration on eight H100 GPUs, MegaRing achieves geometric-mean core-attention speedups of $1.23\times$ forward and $1.18\times$ backward, and accelerates a Transformer layer by $1.08$--$1.16\times$. MegaDCP achieves geometric-mean core-attention speedups of $1.20\times$ for decode-only and $1.35\times$ for mixed batches. In vLLM serving with KV prefix cache, it achieves an average time-to-first-token speedup of $1.22\times$.
original_abstract.source_title: LiquidCP: Decoupling Attention Tasks from Communication and Kernel Boundaries in Context Parallelism

en.text: LiquidCP schedules context-parallel attention as tile-dependent transfer, compute, and reduction tasks rather than tying execution to communication and kernel boundaries. MegaRing balances token and attention loads for training/prefill, while MegaDCP schedules history-KV splits for decoding. On eight H100s, MegaRing improves core-attention forward/backward speed by 1.23×/1.18× and Transformer-layer speed by 1.08–1.16×. Its load balancing and overlap mechanisms are relevant to distributed long-history rankers, with recommendation-specific benefits still unverified.

zh.text: LiquidCP 将上下文并行注意力拆分为具有 tile 级依赖的传输、计算和归约任务，避免执行被通信步骤与 kernel 边界绑定。MegaRing 为训练及 prefill 平衡 token 和注意力负载，MegaDCP 则调度解码阶段的历史 KV 分片。在八张 H100 上，MegaRing 的核心注意力前向与反向分别加速至 1.23 倍和 1.18 倍，Transformer 层加速至 1.08–1.16 倍。其负载均衡和通信计算重叠机制适用于分布式长行为序列排序的优化探索，但推荐场景收益仍待验证。

original_abstract.text: Sparse attention limits the history read by each query, but serving long contexts still requires substantial GPU memory. Existing KV offloading systems retain the full history of indexer keys on GPU, limiting decode concurrency. Prefill's temporary memory demand can further delay admission even when enough memory remains for the same request's subsequent decode. We present LeanSparse, a serving system that reduces both decode's persistent memory use and prefill's temporary memory demand. Our design exploits two observations: prefill consumes historical data one layer at a time, and decode can identify promising candidates before comparing their original indexer scores. During prefill, LeanSparse streams layer histories through two reusable GPU buffers, overlapping next-layer loading with ongoing model computation. During decode, coarse-to-fine indexing searches compact representations and retrieves original indexer keys only for candidate refinement. Separate indexer key and KV caches reuse data across generation steps. We implement LeanSparse in SGLang and evaluate it on DeepSeek-V4-Flash. At 950K context length, LeanSparse supports 2.95$\times$ as many concurrent requests and achieves 2.14$\times$ decode throughput over HiSparse. On multi-turn Open-SWE traces, it reduces median time to first token from 21.6 to 0.6s and median session completion time by 17.7% relative to ECHO.
original_abstract.source_title: LeanSparse: Memory-Efficient Serving for Native Sparse-Attention LLMs

en.text: LeanSparse reduces both persistent decode memory and temporary prefill memory for native sparse-attention models. It streams prefill histories through two reusable GPU buffers and uses compact coarse-to-fine indexing to fetch original indexer keys only for candidate refinement, with separate indexer and KV caches. Implemented in SGLang on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, it reports 2.95x concurrency and 2.14x decode throughput over HiSparse at 950K context, plus lower multi-turn latency in the evaluated traces.

zh.text: LeanSparse同时处理原生稀疏注意力的解码常驻内存与预填充临时内存：预填充按层用两个GPU缓冲区交替加载历史，解码先用紧凑表示粗筛，再仅取候选的原始索引键精排，并分别缓存索引键与KV。其SGLang实现基于DeepSeek-V4-Flash，在950K上下文下相对HiSparse支持2.95倍并发、达到2.14倍解码吞吐。分层流式加载与粗细两级检索可供超长行为历史服务设计参考。

original_abstract.text: Generative recommendation is gaining traction in production, retrieving items by generating their identifiers one token at a time. The generated sequences must identify relevant catalog items, so constrained decoding couples relevance scoring with validity filtering. Because most possible sequences are invalid, scoring before filtering wastes computation on candidates that will be discarded. Our evaluation shows that filtering first can avoid this work with negligible impact on recommendation quality. We present ZeroGR, a filtering-first constrained decoding system for generative recommendation. ZeroGR uses a step-sliced filtering index to reduce GPU memory use by tailoring data representations to each decoding step. Its execution engine adopts shared-slot execution to accelerate data exchange across stages and hybrid projection to adapt computation to workload patterns, thereby reducing execution overhead. During index refreshes, ZeroGR applies layout-guided streaming construction to speed up updates and limit serving interference. Extensive evaluation shows that ZeroGR accelerates the filtering and scoring pipeline by up to $9.9\times$ over representative baselines while reducing GPU index memory use and accelerating index reconstruction.
original_abstract.source_title: ZeroGR: Filtering-First Constrained Decoding for Generative Recommendation

en.text: Targets wasted computation in generative recommendation when invalid identifier sequences are scored before being filtered. ZeroGR filters first, uses a step-sliced index to reduce GPU memory, and combines shared-slot execution, workload-adaptive hybrid projection and layout-guided streaming index construction. Evaluations report up to 9.9× acceleration of the filtering-and-scoring pipeline over representative baselines, with negligible recommendation-quality impact, lower GPU index memory and faster reconstruction. CTR scaling takeaway: validity-aware execution can free serving budget for larger generative retrieval models; the maximum speedup applies to this pipeline, not demonstrated end-to-end CTR serving or CTR quality gains.

zh.text: 针对生成式推荐中先评分、再过滤无效标识符序列造成的计算浪费，ZeroGR 将过滤前置，并采用按解码步切分的索引降低 GPU 内存占用，结合共享槽位执行、适配负载的混合投影和布局引导的流式索引构建。评估中，过滤与评分流水线相对代表性基线最高加速 9.9 倍，推荐质量影响很小，同时降低 GPU 索引内存并加快索引重建。对 CTR scaling 的启发：面向有效候选的执行方式可能为更大的生成式召回模型释放服务预算；最高加速比仅对应这段流水线，并非已验证的端到端 CTR 服务加速或 CTR 指标提升。

original_abstract.text: Industrial recommender systems allocate substantial computation to pointwise candidate scoring, yet separate reranking and mix-ranking stages still assemble the final exposure slate using hand-crafted rules and specialized low-capacity models. Mix-ranking combines product cards, short videos, livestreams, and advertising cards supplied by distinct upstream business channels. Although these rules and models encode valuable domain knowledge, they are inherently limited in leveraging additional data and computation. They constrain the combinatorial space of candidate slates and determine objective trade-offs through manual tuning. To enable scalable and effective slate generation, we reformulate reranking and mix-ranking as a unified learning problem whose performance can improve with computation. Specifically, we instantiate this formulation across the reranking and mix-ranking stages and propose OneTrans-GSR, a single decoder-only policy that extends our deployed OneTrans backbone to generate the exposure slate end-to-end. During training, a reward model evaluates complete slates and guides reinforcement learning toward slate-level and long-term objectives. During decoding, business constraints are explicitly enforced. Offline evaluation shows that slate quality consistently improves as reward-model and policy compute increase. Deployed in a large-scale industrial recommendation system, OneTrans-GSR mixes heterogeneous content types within a unified slate. In online A/B tests, it improves GMV/u by 2.63%, advertiser value by 2.06%, and repurchase rate by 2.03%, while reducing end-to-end latency across the reranking and mix-ranking stages by 13%. These results mark a paradigm shift in slate generation: moving beyond human-engineered heuristics toward a general learned policy creates a scalable path for further algorithmic optimization and compute-driven improvement.
original_abstract.source_title: OneTrans-GSR: A Generative Slate Ranking Paradigm Unifying Reranking and Mix-Ranking with One Autoregressive Transformer

en.text: Replaces separately engineered reranking and heterogeneous-content mix-ranking with one decoder-only slate-generation policy. A complete-slate reward model guides reinforcement learning toward slate-level and long-term objectives, while decoding explicitly enforces business constraints. Offline slate quality improves with reward-model and policy compute. Industrial online A/B tests report gains of 2.63% in GMV/u, 2.06% in advertiser value and 2.03% in repurchase rate, with 13% lower end-to-end latency across reranking and mix-ranking. CTR scaling takeaway: move beyond pointwise scoring toward compute-scalable slate optimization, while measuring business outcomes and constraints; the abstract reports no CTR gain or fitted scaling law.

zh.text: 将分别设计的重排和异构内容混排统一为单个 decoder-only 列表生成策略。完整列表奖励模型通过强化学习引导列表级和长期目标，解码时显式执行业务约束。离线结果显示，奖励模型和策略计算量增加时，列表质量持续改善。工业在线 A/B 测试报告 GMV/u 提升 2.63%、广告主价值提升 2.06%、复购率提升 2.03%，重排与混排阶段的端到端延迟下降 13%。对 CTR scaling 的启发：从逐候选打分拓展到可随算力增长的列表优化，同时评估业务指标与约束；摘要未报告 CTR 增益或拟合的 scaling law。

original_abstract.text: Dense retrieval models are typically obtained by fine-tuning pretrained language models on supervised retrieval data, where high-quality annotations or interaction logs are often limited and reused across many epochs. This data-constrained regime differs from the abundant-data setting assumed by standard scaling laws, making it unclear how the best attainable retrieval performance changes with model size and unique fine-tuning data. We study this question through the minimum achievable evaluation loss (MAEL), defined as the lowest evaluation loss reached during training under fixed model-size and data-budget constraints. We first show that learning-rate choices strongly affect optimization trajectories but have little effect on the final attainable MAEL: after rescaling the optimization-step axis, learning curves collapse across learning rates, and CKA analysis shows that checkpoints reaching MAEL learn highly similar representations. We then fine-tune 35 BERT-family dense retrievers on MS MARCO subsets and find that MAEL is accurately described by a simple multiplicative power law over non-embedding parameters and unique samples, outperforming commonly used additive scaling formulations. We further derive a scaling law for the training step at which MAEL is reached and show that optimal weight decay follows an approximately invariant EMA timescale, yielding lower MAEL and stronger retrieval performance on both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks. Finally, combining loss and step scaling suggests that, in our observed regime, increasing pretrained model size is approximately 1.46 times as fine-tuning-compute-efficient as increasing unique in-domain data for reducing MAEL.
original_abstract.source_title: Scaling Laws For Data-Constrained Dense Retrieval

en.text: Studies scaling when supervised retrieval data are limited and reused across epochs. Across 35 BERT-family retrievers fine-tuned on MS MARCO subsets, minimum achievable evaluation loss (MAEL) follows a multiplicative power law in non-embedding parameters and unique samples more closely than additive alternatives. The paper also models steps to MAEL and relates optimal weight decay to an approximately invariant EMA timescale. In the observed regime, increasing pretrained model size is approximately 1.46 times as fine-tuning-compute-efficient as increasing unique in-domain data for reducing MAEL. CTR scaling takeaway: test joint model/data/optimization scaling under repeated-data training; the reported law and efficiency ratio are retrieval-specific findings, not established CTR results.

zh.text: 研究监督检索数据有限、需要跨多个 epoch 重复使用时的扩展规律。在 MS MARCO 子集上微调的 35 个 BERT 系列检索模型中，以非嵌入参数量和独立样本数构建的乘法幂律，比加法形式更好地拟合最低可达评估损失（MAEL）。论文还建模达到 MAEL 所需的训练步数，并将最优权重衰减与近似不变的 EMA 时间尺度联系起来。在其观测范围内，为降低 MAEL，扩大预训练模型的微调算力效率约为增加独立域内数据的 1.46 倍。对 CTR scaling 的启发：在数据重复训练条件下联合考察模型、数据与优化配置；该规律与效率比例尚不能直接视为 CTR 结论。

original_abstract.text: Looped transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared set of transformer layers, offering a parameter-efficient way to scale computation. However, standard residual connections aggregate information across recurrent depth into a single stream, providing limited control over which intermediate representations from preceding layers should be reused. In this paper, we introduce ARLoop, a looped transformer architecture based on attention residuals, where the input of each layer is selectively aggregated through attention over model depth. Distinct from standard transformers, we find that looped transformers do not require access to the full residual history: sliding-window depth attention matches or outperforms full-history attention at larger recurrent depths. Across controlled experiments with multiple parameter scales (140M and 370M) and recurrent depths (R = 1 to 5), ARLoop consistently outperforms prior residual designs for looped transformers. More importantly, we further scale ARLoop to 0.6B and 1.2B parameters under a realistic LLM pretraining recipe, demonstrating that the gains transfer to realistic pretraining, with particularly strong improvements on math and coding tasks. Our 1.2B model, pretrained on only 0.5T tokens with three recurrences, outperforms Huginn-3.5B (the only fully-open looped LLM as of our release date) across all evaluated tasks and is competitive with similar-sized non-looped models such as Qwen3.5-2B despite being trained on substantially less data.
original_abstract.source_title: ARLoop: Fully-Open Pre-trained Looped Transformers with Attention Residuals

en.text: ARLoop combines shared-layer recurrence with attention residuals that selectively reuse representations across depth. Sliding-window depth attention matches or exceeds full-history attention at larger recurrent depths, with gains observed in controlled 140M/370M experiments and 0.6B/1.2B pretraining. The design suggests a parameter-efficient way to scale ranking-model depth while limiting residual-history access; the reported evaluations are language-model tasks, not CTR.

zh.text: ARLoop 将共享层循环与注意力残差结合，选择性复用不同深度的表示。在较大循环深度下，滑动窗口式深度注意力达到或超过完整历史注意力，收益同时出现在 140M/370M 参数的受控实验及 0.6B/1.2B 参数的预训练中。该设计为排序模型提供了参数高效的深度扩展方式，并可限制残差历史访问范围；论文评测针对语言模型任务，而非 CTR。

original_abstract.text:
Whole-page ranking jointly optimizes advertisements and organic content to balance business outcomes and user engagement under complex layout and business constraints. Existing non-autoregressive (NAR) approaches enable efficient page generation but typically score candidate items independently of previously selected items, limiting their ability to capture order-dependent interactions. Autoregressive (AR) methods address this limitation through sequential conditioning, but incur substantial inference overhead that challenges large-scale deployment. Bridging this quality-efficiency gap remains a challenge in industrial whole-page ranking.
  We propose Multi-Item Scoring (MIS), a prefix-aware NAR-style framework that incorporates sequential context into efficient multi-item scoring. MIS integrates global candidate interactions, localized prefix conditioning, and position-aware scoring within a shared representation architecture. By computing reusable representations once per request and performing lightweight prefix-conditioned scoring during constrained beam search, MIS captures important sequential dependencies without repeated full-model inference.
  Experiments on KuaiRand-1K and RL4RS demonstrate that MIS approaches the generation quality of an autoregressive CGA baseline while achieving 4.07x and 3.54x faster CPU decoding, respectively. In a randomized evaluation on a large-scale social-video platform, MIS improves the realization metric by 0.104% and watch time by 0.058%, while reducing ranking-service CPU consumption by 9.73%. These results demonstrate that prefix-aware multi-item scoring can narrow the quality gap between NAR and AR generation while retaining the efficiency required for industrial scalability.
original_abstract.source_title: Towards Efficient Whole Page Ranking with One-Pass Inference

en.text: MIS targets the quality–latency trade-off in whole-page ads–organic ranking. It computes shared candidate representations once, then combines global interactions, prefix conditioning and position-aware lightweight scoring during constrained beam search. On KuaiRand-1K and RL4RS it approaches an autoregressive CGA baseline's generation quality with 4.07x and 3.54x faster CPU decoding; the reported randomized industrial evaluation improves realization by 0.104% and watch time by 0.058% while reducing ranking-service CPU use by 9.73%.

zh.text: MIS面向广告与自然内容混排，把候选表示在每个请求内只计算一次，再在约束束搜索中用轻量前缀条件打分复用这些表示，同时保留候选交互和位置关系。在KuaiRand-1K与RL4RS上，生成质量接近自回归CGA基线，CPU解码分别加速4.07倍和3.54倍；作者报告的线上随机实验中，realization指标提高0.104%、观看时长提高0.058%，排序服务CPU消耗降低9.73%。

original_abstract.text: Large-scale ranking and recommendation models of Web platforms benefit from increased compute much as large language models do, and their scaling behavior is broadly power-law in form. Yet ranking models have heterogeneous architectures which makes their scaling law less straightforward than that of LLMs. We address how to discover the scaling law of an arbitrary ranking model efficiently. We introduce a scaling layer, which groups primitive architecture parameters into semantically coherent groups and defines how they co-vary, inducing a mapping from a low-dimensional space of hyper-hyperparameters into the full architecture space. On top of it, Axia fits scaling-informed surrogates, selects configurations by a posterior-based acquisition criterion, and returns a Pareto frontier from which per-model operating points are validated -- replacing exhaustive sweeps with a small number of informative runs. A fleet-level evaluation protocol, computed on a fixed representative model set under matched trial budgets, makes refinements to either component measurable. Our contribution is an automated system that learns model-specific complexity-quality relationships and gives uncertainty-aware guidance for allocating compute across a heterogeneous model ecosystem. Across 34 model iterations in two development cycles on Meta's ads ranking and retrieval system, the workflow yielded a mean 0.66% offline normalized-entropy improvement and 0.36% cumulative online lift.
original_abstract.source_title: Data-Efficient Scaling-Law Discovery for Recommendation Systems via Coupled Hyperparameter Scaling

en.text: Axia learns model-specific quality–compute relationships for heterogeneous recommendation and ranking architectures with fewer trial runs. A scaling layer couples related architecture parameters into low-dimensional controls; scaling-informed surrogate models and posterior-based acquisition select informative configurations and construct a Pareto frontier. Across 34 model iterations in two Meta development cycles, the authors report a mean 0.66% offline normalized-entropy improvement and 0.36% cumulative online lift.

zh.text: 针对推荐排序模型结构异构、穷举扩模成本高的问题，Axia先把相关架构参数组合成少量联动的扩模控制量，再利用带规模规律先验的代理模型与后验采集策略选择实验，形成质量与计算成本的帕累托前沿。作者在Meta两个开发周期、34次模型迭代中报告平均0.66%的离线归一化熵改善和累计0.36%的线上提升，为有限实验预算下的扩模和算力分配提供方法。

original_abstract.text: Modern recommender systems rely on generative retrieval techniques to predict the next item either as discrete codes or as a continuous vector. On the one hand, Semantic IDs (SIDs) give discrete models shared parameters and pretrained semantic structure, but discretizing items into hard codes discards some information from the original content embeddings. On the other hand, continuous models avoid quantization, yet typically use flat item lookup tables with no explicit parameter tying across items. We ask whether a continuous recommender can introduce shared structure without making it a discrete bottleneck. We propose CAP-Mix, a flow recommender that represents each item as a soft mixture of shared prototypes plus an item-specific vector. The assignments, prototypes, and item vectors are trained jointly, and the soft representation is retained at inference. Pretrained information is optional: SID responsibilities can serve as a prior over assignments, while a full content embedding can initialize the item-specific vector without changing the initial flat table. In matched comparisons on three datasets, CAP-Mix improves over a flat table on the two sparse Amazon datasets and yields a small gain on Steam when trained without pretrained information. Given only an offline SID, it outperforms a hard table built from the same tokenizer by 4.45-14.90% in HR@5. Given the full content embedding, it matches or improves a strong flat table while hard assignments regress on the sparse Amazon datasets. Overall, averaged across six benchmarks, CAP-Mix improves HR@5 and NDCG@5 by 6.9% and 13.6% relative to the best evaluated baseline for each dataset and metric, while delivering 1.4-161x the inference throughput of the discrete baselines in our experiments.
original_abstract.source_title: Item Representations Matter: Bridging Hard Semantic IDs and Soft Prototype Mixtures for Generative Retrieval

en.text: CAP-Mix gives continuous generative retrieval shared item structure without a hard discrete bottleneck. Each item combines a soft mixture of shared prototypes with an item-specific vector; assignments, prototypes and vectors train jointly and remain soft at inference, with optional semantic-ID priors or content initialization. Matched comparisons examine sparse Amazon and Steam settings. Across six benchmarks the authors report average HR@5 and NDCG@5 gains of 6.9% and 13.6% over each metric's best evaluated baseline, with throughput depending on the discrete baseline.

zh.text: CAP-Mix用共享原型的软混合加物品专属向量来表示物品，让连续生成召回获得跨物品参数共享，同时保留推理时的软表示。分配权重、原型和物品向量联合训练，也可用语义ID先验或内容向量初始化。论文通过稀疏Amazon与Steam上的对齐实验分析软结构的收益，并在六个基准上报告相对各数据集最佳所测基线的平均HR@5和NDCG@5提升为6.9%与13.6%；吞吐优势依比较的离散基线而变。

original_abstract.text: Expert deactivation at inference time changes both token routing and expert weights, and its effect on performance depends on how these changes are implemented. We compare removal, freezing, remaining-expert renormalization, and unnormalized re-routing on identical disabled sets across five instruction-tuned checkpoints from four model families, with a base OLMoE checkpoint as an additional comparison. We develop a weight-sum model that relates the loss of expert contributions and changes in branch scale to the weight rule used during training. With half of the experts deactivated according to activation-based rankings, remaining-expert renormalization yields the highest perplexity in models trained with raw router probabilities, whereas unnormalized re-routing yields the highest perplexity in models trained with normalized weights. Perplexity ranges from 1.4 to 73 times the intact baseline when the training rule is retained, and from 14 to 28,740 times the baseline under a rule mismatch. Task outcomes vary across evaluation types: on OLMoE, GSM8K strict-match accuracy falls to zero under all four implementations. Extending the model to changes in the number of active experts yields a further prediction, supported by the OLMoE experiments: the perplexity penalty from additional renormalization increases as fewer experts are activated.
original_abstract.source_title: Matching the Training-Time Weight Rule in Inference-Time Expert Deactivation

en.text: This study isolates how expert deactivation interacts with the router weighting rule used in training. It compares removal, freezing, remaining-expert renormalization and unnormalized rerouting on identical disabled sets across five instruction-tuned checkpoints from four families, plus a base OLMoE model. With half the experts disabled, retaining the training rule yields perplexity of 1.4–73x the intact baseline; mismatches yield 14–28,740x. Even matching the rule does not guarantee task quality: OLMoE GSM8K strict-match accuracy falls to zero under all four implementations. Expert compression therefore needs routing-scale and task-level checks, not just expert importance rankings.

zh.text: 这项研究把专家停用的实现方式与训练时路由权重规则分开检查。在四个模型家族的五个指令微调checkpoint及一个基础OLMoE模型上，它对同一批停用专家比较移除、冻结、剩余专家重归一化和不归一化重路由。停用一半专家时，保留训练权重规则的困惑度为完整模型的1.4–73倍，规则错配时为14–28,740倍。但规则匹配也不保证任务效果：OLMoE的GSM8K严格匹配准确率在四种实现下都降到零。压缩专家时应同时检查路由尺度和任务指标，不能只依赖专家重要性排名。

original_abstract.text: As sequence lengths continue to grow, distributed attention based on sequence parallel (e.g., Ring-Attention) has become a mainstream solution for large language models (LLMs). Nevertheless, inherent communication dependencies limit computation-communication overlap, reducing GPU utilization. Moreover, in cross-hardware (NUMA or node) architectures, due to imbalanced communication bandwidth, frequent communication synchronization will limit overall performance. Based on these insights, we propose CHARM+, Cross-Hardware Attention with Re-Merge Multistream Mechanism. We reorganize sequential communications into several levels and achieve intra-level parallelism and computation overlap. Furthermore, we decouple cross-hardware communication from intra-hardware communication, eliminating synchronization overhead caused by bandwidth imbalance. Forward and backward algorithms were evaluated on multiple hardware architectures and consistently outperformed state-of-the-art methods. Compared to Ring-Attention, our forward and backward algorithms achieve average speedups of 1.3x and 1.7x on a dual-NUMA PCIe architecture, and 2.8x and 2.9x on a dual-node NVLink architecture, respectively.
original_abstract.source_title: CHARM+: Cross-Hardware Attention with Re-Merge Multistream Mechanism

en.text: CHARM+ reorganizes distributed long-sequence attention communication into levels to overlap transfers and computation. It separates cross-NUMA or cross-node exchanges from local communication to reduce synchronization under unequal bandwidth. Relative to Ring-Attention, reported average forward/backward speedups are 1.3x/1.7x on dual-NUMA PCIe and 2.8x/2.9x on dual-node NVLink systems. These are attention implementation measurements, with potential relevance to distributed long-history model training.

zh.text: CHARM+把分布式长序列注意力的串行通信重排成多个层级，增加同层并发与计算重叠，并把跨NUMA或跨节点交换同局部通信解耦，减少带宽不均造成的同步等待。相对Ring-Attention，作者报告双NUMA PCIe配置前向与反向平均加速1.3倍和1.7倍，双节点NVLink配置为2.8倍和2.9倍。这类通信调度可供长历史模型训练参考，数字对应论文的Attention实现实验。

original_abstract.text: Second-stage neural rankers are commonly applied with a fixed re-ranking depth, assuming that retrieval effectiveness saturates as depth increases. Prior research has questioned the assumption that increasing the re-ranking depth yields linear performance gains, further suggesting that optimal re-ranking depth varies considerably from query to query. In the past, studying such phenomena was methodologically difficult given the scale of manual annotation required. With the advent of LLM-based relevance judgments we can now more easily undertake such studies, in this case to pinpoint the optimal re-ranking depth on a per-query basis. Using dense LLM-based relevance judgments over a typical re-ranking pipeline, we show that many queries exhibit a well-defined optimal re-ranking depth, beyond which effectiveness stagnates or degrades. We formulate re-ranking depth as a query-specific property and study whether it can be predicted a priori from first-stage retrieval characteristics. Through a large-scale analysis, we find that most standard query performance prediction (QPP) methods are ineffective for this task. In contrast, a predictor derived from LLM-assessed first-stage ranking quality, which we term IR-DCG@10, can reduce the average re-ranking depth by up to a factor of 3 while preserving overall effectiveness, depending on the specific first- and second-stage rankers used. Under oracle selection of optimal depths, we further show that retrieval effectiveness can improve by more than 7% while reducing the average re-ranking depth by a factor of 5 on the MSMARCO DEV collection. Given our promising preliminary findings, we would encourage the use of automatic judgments to facilitate research otherwise infeasible under manual annotation. Towards this point, we release relevance judgments, our codebase, and experimental artefacts to support reproducibility and further research.
original_abstract.source_title: Optimal Re-Ranking Depth

en.text: This study treats reranking depth as query-dependent rather than fixed. Dense LLM relevance judgments reveal saturation or degradation beyond each query's preferred depth, while common query-performance predictors transfer poorly. An IR-DCG@10 predictor based on LLM-assessed first-stage quality reduces mean reranking depth by up to 3x while preserving effectiveness in the evaluated pipelines. Larger oracle improvements are upper bounds, and the judgments introduce a dependency on LLM assessment quality.

zh.text: 论文把重排深度视为查询相关的决策，借助密集LLM相关性标注发现：增加候选数量可能出现收益饱和甚至效果下降，常见查询性能预测方法也难以直接预测最优深度。由首阶段排序质量构造的IR-DCG@10预测器，在所测排序组合中最多把平均重排深度降低到约三分之一并保持效果。对推荐系统的启发是按请求分配重排计算量；Oracle结果仅代表上界，标注质量依赖LLM判断。

original_abstract.text: Hyper-Connections (HC) architectures are increasingly adopted in frontier language models, yet their components remain insufficiently understood and introduce non-negligible training overhead. In this work, we systematically study the HC architecture to understand its components and identify simpler, more efficient designs. We find that learned read/write gating without mixing and unconstrained mixing with fixed gates form two effective interaction groups: either alone achieves performance comparable to mHC. We also identify repeated access to the expanded residual state as a major source of training overhead, even without mixing. These findings lead to SimpleHC, which simplifies the architecture by removing residual mixing and simplifies execution through shared memory access, using the resulting additive structure and shared gate inputs. Layer-specific gates share a group-entry state, enabling batched reads and deferred writes; scalar corrections exactly preserve preceding sublayer output contributions. Our analyses support both the retained residual structure and the design of shared memory access. SimpleHC incurs only 2.4% extra end-to-end training time over a vanilla residual baseline at the largest tested scale. It maintains performance comparable to mHC when scaling from 15B to 30B MoE models, exhibits smoother gradient dynamics during standard training, and remains stable under stress. We hope SimpleHC will encourage a broader pursuit of simplicity in foundation model design, making performance gains more accessible and practical at scale.
original_abstract.source_title: On the Design of Hyper-Connections: Simplification, Stability, and Scalability

en.text: SimpleHC studies which Hyper-Connection components justify their training cost. It removes residual mixing while retaining learned read/write gates, then shares memory access through batched reads and deferred writes with scalar corrections that preserve preceding update contributions. Across 15B–30B MoE models, it maintains performance comparable to mHC; at the largest tested scale, end-to-end training takes only 2.4% longer than a vanilla residual baseline. It also reports smoother training gradients and stability under stress. Separating useful residual-state structure from expensive memory access could guide deeper recommendation architectures, which are not tested here.

zh.text: SimpleHC研究Hyper-Connection中哪些结构值得付出训练开销。它移除残差混合，保留可学习的读写门，再通过批量读取、延后写回和标量校正共享内存访问，同时保留前序更新的贡献。在15B–30B MoE模型上，效果与mHC相当；最大测试规模下，端到端训练耗时仅比普通残差基线多2.4%，并报告更平滑的梯度和压力测试稳定性。把有效的残差状态结构与昂贵的内存访问拆开优化，可供深层推荐架构参考，论文未验证这一迁移。

original_abstract.text: Helping users discover new interests is vital to the long-term health of industrial recommender systems, yet the usual remedy, boosting exposure of under-explored (discovery) content, often backfires in production. We report URED (Unexposed Recycling for Efficient Discovery), a training-free recall-stage system serving Taobao feed recommendation at Alibaba for over six months to tens of millions of daily active users. It rests on a production-validated insight: naive boosting fails because it injects cold, information-poor candidates that rankers systematically over-estimate, buying no discovery gain while risking engagement. Items scored highly but never exposed (signals industrial pipelines routinely discard) form a pool that is both relevant and reliably predictable. Over a 30-day horizon URED aggregates them and re-injects at recall time through a lightweight pipeline spanning offline storage, distributed aggregation, and low-latency online serving, adding under 1% latency via a single O(1) lookup per request with no model retraining. Online A/B tests show +3.47% discovered categories and +8.47% content richness with engagement preserved: completion video views rise significantly (+2.62%) and total views move positive (+0.36%, not significant). Ablations confirm both design pillars are necessary: a one-day window collapses the discovery gain to +0.55% (not significant), and random injection without score filtering yields no gain while trending negative on engagement (-0.17%). Across production recall channels, URED reaches 13.9x the platform-average discovery rate (6.3x the strongest nearline baseline) at engagement quality on par with the platform average. We share deployment details and lessons for practitioners facing the exploration-exploitation dilemma under tight resource constraints.
original_abstract.source_title: From Waste to Discovery: Recycling High-Scored Unexposed Candidates in Taobao Feed Recommendation

en.text: URED reuses high-scored but unexposed items instead of injecting poorly understood cold candidates for discovery. A 30-day pool feeds a training-free recall pipeline with one O(1) lookup per request and under 1% added latency. In Taobao feed A/B tests, discovered categories rise 3.47% and completed video views rise 2.62%; the 0.36% total-view increase is not statistically significant. Shortening the pool to one day or removing score filtering removes the reliable discovery gain. The system illustrates how existing ranking signals can support exploration without another model, rather than demonstrating model-scaling gains.

zh.text: URED回收高分但未曝光的商品，用这些已有较可靠排序信号的候选做兴趣发现，避免直接注入信息不足的冷候选。系统汇总30天候选，无需重新训练，每次请求只做一次O(1)查找，新增延迟低于1%。淘宝信息流A/B测试中，发现品类增加3.47%，完播量增加2.62%；总播放量增加0.36%，未达统计显著。把窗口缩到一天，或去掉分数过滤，都不再有可靠的发现收益。可借鉴的是用现有排序信号低成本补充探索，而不是模型规模扩展结论。
